notes.title: hotfix path 1.01
notes.content:
Hello.
I read all your reviews and made a couple of fixes:

-Now all animations can be interrupted much earlier.
-During a combo strike, you can change the direction of the character
-Fixed glitches that occurred when a character collided with mushrooms and thorns at the same time
-Now the trap is always visible, and not only during the action
-Fixed bugs with pause and options menu
-Fixed conditions for obtaining achievement for 100 deaths. Now it works correctly

[i]Thank you for your support.[/i]
